audit.whatIsWrong: Level 1 and the two late-game rows (First item, 2+ items) show phases[N].side = Skill while the content-layer win[N] already says Maokai / Alistar / Alistar for those same rows — the chart contradicts itself.
audit.why: Twisted Advance is point-and-click and Bramble Smash pokes at 600 range, both landing before Alistar's telegraphed W-Q reaches him, so Maokai wins Level 1. Once Unbreakable Will and a first item come online, Alistar's durability and stun-chain outlast Maokai's shorter, weaker-range CC.
audit.corrected: phases[0].side -> Maokai, phases[5].side -> Alistar, phases[6].side -> Alistar, with why text updated to match.

edits.before: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root): matchup-defining — Point-and-click root — count its cooldown before stepping up. It writes your spacing rules. - R Unbreakable Will is for saving fights, not seasoning trades. - The R opens or closes fights — pick one per cast.
edits.after: - Maokai Twisted Advance (Root) is 14s at rank 1, down to 10s at rank 5 — track it before you step up, since it's his only gap-closer. - Your Trample (E), 12-10s cooldown, grounds it mid-dash. - Unbreakable Will (R) is for saving fights, not seasoning trades.

edits.after: Good trade: chip through Sap Magic's lifesteal with poke, not one big trade — his passive out-heals single hits. Bad trade: all-in without Grievous Wounds up; his sustain wins the extended fight even behind.
